newsitem.title: GERMANY: German 96 air cargo market sales, tonnage by region.
newsitem.headline: German 96 air cargo market sales, tonnage by region.

text.p: Air cargo sales through the IATA Cargo Accounts Settlement System (CASS) covered 70 percent of the German air cargo market last year, CASS said.
CASS is the official International Air Transport Association (IATA) accounting system between airlines and cargo agents.
Total 1996 sales through CASS, including both pre-paid and collect payment sales between airlines and IATA cargo agents, amounted to 1.48 billion marks, CASS figures showed.

Total net payments, excluding agents' commissions, came to 1.36 billion marks, according to the figures. A total of 1,609,000 air waybills were issued last year between the 78 airlines and 814 agents' offices covered in the CASS Germany network.
The overall German air cargo market, including non-CASS sales, was worth nearly US$ 1.21 billion last year, or up to 2.09 billion marks at the current exchange rate of $1 DM 1.73.
The top 15 German cargo agents are estimated to handle about 85 percent of the overall German air cargo market, industry observers said.
